description: Double-cab pickup truck, the best-selling vehicle in Thailand and the base for most working and converted trucks.

image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Double-cab pickup truck, four doors, tall slatted grille and squared headlamps, flared wheel arches, open cargo bed with side rails and a drop tailgate, side steps Materials: Clean metallic paint with black plastic bumpers and arch trim, chrome grille bar, dusty lower panels and bed floor, road grime behind the wheels.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Real trademark: Toyota Hilux / Toyota Motor. The repo's MIT licence covers this asset's code, not the mark; anyone shipping it needs their own trademark clearance.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.86. 4,568/8,000 triangles, 4/6 draw calls, 3/4 materials, 4/8 unique geometries, one 512 px canvas at 1.3 MB, factory 74 ms.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope built at 1.86 x 1.80 x 5.33 m over the body (mirrors to 2.06) against a declared 1.86 x 1.82 x 5.33; band table against the Meshy proxy mean |delta width| 0.14, |delta depth| 0.44 of height, of which the depth is the declared aspect (proxy 2.29 L/H, real 2.93) and the width the proxy's narrower cab.
featureReviews.notes: Heights read off the proxy side elevation (roof 1.00 H, belt and rail 0.66 H, wheel top 0.40 H, sill 0.26 H) and stations as fractions of length (cab roof 0.29-0.625 L). The proxy cab is narrower at the top three bands (0.72-0.80 H against 0.94) and the tumblehome was deepened to 0.17 in response.

featureReviews.evidence: Three chrome bars in a dark grille recess between two rectangular lamps over a black bumper 7 cm proud of the nose, its corners and the lamps rotated to wrap the 0.24 m plan nose; windscreen 1 cm ahead of the rake and reading as glass; black arch flares, mirrors on stems, handles, shut lines, sill steps, indicators.
featureReviews.notes: The plate's front is the crop 200..300 x 700..760: black bumper full width, lamps outboard, barred grille centred. Built as forty tinted boxes on one white material.

featureReviews.evidence: Four instanced 0.75 m wheels off one lathe with a dished rim a step lighter than the tyre; pivots wheel-front-l/r and wheel-rear-l/r on the axle at each hub, exposed on sculptRuntime.
featureReviews.notes: Muddy steel wheels in the plate (region-tyre 0.86); rim #8a827a against tyre #5e5750.

featureReviews.evidence: Paint material carries the mud envelope #8b8075; the clean #385176 rides a 512 px canvas as the linear-space ratio (0.43, 0.65, 1.00); mud as a wash to 0.36 of a 2 m height-keyed tile plus soft blobs.
featureReviews.notes: The first render was PURPLE: the ratio had been formed in sRGB. Re-formed in linear space it renders the plate's muted blue. The first splatter read as confetti and was cut from 220 to 90 blobs.

notes: 5.33 m double-cab length puts this in the hero budget class, past the vehicle category's 4.5 m prior -- the estimate is the real vehicle, not a mistake. Shares its massing and cab with the Isuzu D-Max; the two are kept separate because the grille, lamp and arch treatment differ enough to read as different trucks in a street scene, which is the whole reason a level builder wants both.
